verses.1: Now the serpent was the most clever of all the animals the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, "Did God really say you cannot eat from any tree in the garden?"
verses.2: The woman said to the serpent, "We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden.
verses.3: But about the tree in the middle of the garden, God said, 'Do not eat from it and do not touch it, or you will die.'"
verses.4: The serpent said to the woman, "You will not die.
verses.5: God knows that when you eat from it your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."
verses.6: The woman saw that the tree looked good for food, that it was beautiful to look at, and that it seemed like it would make her wise. So she took some of its fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it too.
verses.7: Then both of their eyes were opened and they realized they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
verses.8: Later they heard the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool part of the day, and Adam and his wife hid among the trees because they were afraid.
verses.9: The LORD God called out to Adam and said, "Where are you?"
verses.10: Adam said, "I heard You in the garden and I was afraid because I was naked, so I hid."
verses.11: God said, "Who told you that you were naked? Did you eat from the tree I told you not to eat from?"
verses.12: Adam said, "The woman You gave to be with me — she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it."
verses.13: The LORD God said to the woman, "What have you done?" The woman said, "The serpent tricked me, and I ate."
verses.14: The LORD God said to the serpent, "Because you did this, you are cursed more than all animals. You will crawl on your belly and eat dust all the days of your life.
verses.15: I will make you and the woman enemies of each other, and your children and her children will be enemies too. Her child will crush your head, and you will strike his heel."
verses.16: To the woman He said, "I will greatly increase your pain when you have children. In pain you will bring them into the world. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will have authority over you."
verses.17: To Adam He said, "Because you listened to your wife and ate from the tree I told you not to eat from, the ground is now cursed because of you. You will have to work hard to get food from it for the rest of your life.
verses.18: It will grow thorns and weeds, and you will eat plants from the field.
verses.19: You will work hard and sweat to grow your food until you return to the ground, because you were made from dust and to dust you will return."
verses.20: Adam named his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all people who would ever live.
verses.21: The LORD God made clothes from animal skins for Adam and his wife and put them on them.
verses.22: The LORD God said, "Now the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. We must not let him reach out and take from the tree of life and eat from it and live forever."
verses.23: So the LORD God sent Adam out of the garden of Eden to work the ground he had been made from.
verses.24: He drove the man out and placed cherubim (powerful angels) with a flaming sword turning in every direction to guard the way to the tree of life.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
